# Load 4GB csv in chunks using dask
- Filter columns

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
import dask.dataframe as dd

back_dir = os.path.normpath(os.getcwd() + os.sep + os.pardir)
csv_path = os.path.join(back_dir,'hidden','inat-6mil-obs_runv2.csv')


ddf = dd.read_csv(csv_path,blocksize='50MB',delimiter=r'\t',dtype={'speciesKey':'float64','infraspecificEpithet':'object'})

print('Columns:\n',ddf.columns)
# print('\n')
# print(ddf.head())

pd.options.display.max_rows=None
pd.options.display.max_columns=None

# Day,Month,Year is occurrence day,month,year
columns = ['gbifID','occurrenceID','family','genus','species','scientificName','verbatimScientificName','stateProvince','occurrenceStatus','individualCount','decimalLatitude','decimalLongitude','coordinateUncertaintyInMeters','coordinatePrecision','elevation','elevationAccuracy','depth','eventDate','day','month','year','taxonKey','dateIdentified','rightsHolder']
ddf = ddf[columns]
print(ddf.head())

```

# Rename Columns

```{python}
col_map={'scientificName':'accepted_name','verbatimScientificName':'scientific_name','stateProvince':'state_providence','occurrenceStatus':'occurrence_status','individualCount':'individual_count','decimalLatitude':'lat','decimalLongitude':'lon','coordinateUncertaintyInMeters':'coord_uncertainty','coordinatePrecision':'coord_precision','elevationAccuracy':'elevation_accuracy','eventDate':'occurrence_date','dateIdentified':'identification_date'}
ddf = ddf.rename(columns=col_map)
```

# Datatypes

```{python}
ddf.dtypes

ddf['identification_date'] = dd.to_datetime(ddf['identification_date'],format="ISO8601")
ddf['occurrence_date'] = dd.to_datetime(ddf['occurrence_date'],format="ISO8601")
```

# Helper column for species_matchback engine

```{python}
ddf = ddf.assign(first_of_scientific_name=ddf['scientific_name'].map(lambda x: x.split(' ')[0],meta=pd.Series(dtype="object")))
# print(ddf.compute())
```


```{python}
ddf.head()
```

# Save as Parquet

```{python}
parquet_path = os.path.join(back_dir,'hidden','processed-inat-6mil.parquet')
ddf.to_parquet(parquet_path,engine='pyarrow')

csv_path = os.path.join(back_dir,'hidden','processed-inat-6mil.csv')
ddf.to_csv(csv_path)

```

# Load into postgres database

